name: Expanded Storage
desc: Deeper spiral coils so each slot holds more stock and runs dry less often.

name: Faster Restocking
desc: A better rear hatch and stock trolley. Restocking costs less of the night.

levels.effect: 4 minutes per slot, and you can restock while a customer waits

name: Improved Machine Lighting
desc: Brighter, warmer tubes behind the glass. Reflections are clearer and the dark feels further away.

levels.effect: Instability gain -40%; power cuts no longer shake your nerves

name: Enhanced Security Monitor
desc: A sharper night-vision feed and an extra camera on the road.

levels.effect: Unlocks CAM 4 (Route 9) and extra camera observations
Anomaly alert on CAM 2 when a reflection doesn't match
Cameras keep working during power cuts

name: Customer Identification Tool
desc: A handheld scanner Meridian 'does not officially supply'. Reads pulse, temperature and something labeled RESIDUE.

levels.effect: SCAN: basic pulse and residue reading
SCAN: cross-references the handbook sections that apply

name: Emergency Power Backup
desc: A battery bank under the counter. When the lot goes dark, the machine keeps working.

levels.effect: Machine and cameras stay on; power cuts 40% shorter
